sponsored.t: Establishes free public, state-run courses to prepare individuals to become state certified real estate appraisers, state licensed real estate appraisers, and state licensed real estate appraiser assistants
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of state to establish free public, state-run courses to prepare individuals to become state certified real estate appraisers, state licensed real estate appraisers, and state licensed real estate appraiser assistants.
sponsored.fis: The fiscal impact is expected to be minimal.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting 116th Street in the borough of Manhattan between Riverside Drive and FDR Drive from certain bus lane and bus operation-related photo enforcement provisions
sponsored.sum: Exempts 116th Street in the borough of Manhattan between Riverside Drive and FDR Drive from certain bus lane and bus operation-related photo enforcement provisions.
sponsored.fis: The fiscal impact is expected to be minimal.

sponsored.t: Relates to recognizing postpartum psychosis as a condition distinct from postpartum depression and directing the department of health to create screening guidelines for the condition
sponsored.sum: Relates to recognizing postpartum psychosis as a condition distinct from postpartum depression and directing the department of health to create screening guidelines for the condition and provide information to maternal health care providers.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church for a certain premises located in the county of New York.

sponsored.t: Provides for priority status to victims of human trafficking for the receipt of certain assistance
sponsored.sum: Provides for priority for applications and expedited determination of claims for a human trafficking victim who wishes to remove permanent marks that were part of the trafficking of such victim, including but not limited to, tattoos, markings, brandings, or other symbols or insignia.

sponsored.t: Allows a notice of dense breast tissue to be determination of medical necessity for coverage of a breast ultrasound
sponsored.sum: Allows a notice of dense breast tissue to be considered a determination of medical necessity for purposes of coverage of breast ultrasounds as recommended by a provider of mammography services.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a lithium-ion battery safety program
sponsored.sum: Provides that NYSERDA shall establish a program to provide rebates or new lithium-ion batteries for powered mobility devices at reduced cost or no cost to certain individuals; sets standards for lithium-ion batteries provided pursuant to the program; requires NYSERDA to submit an annual report on such program.

sponsored.t: Requires at least one member of the state board of parole be a formerly incarcerated person
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring at least one member of the state board of parole be a formerly incarcerated person.

sponsored.t: Creates the Checkout NY pass
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Creates the "Checkout NY" pass, a comprehensive pass that allows for free or discounted use of state parks, historic sites and recreational facilities; provides one such pass to each consolidated, federated and cooperative public library system within the state free of charge for circulation.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing monetary penalties for public health law violations
sponsored.sum: Increases monetary penalties for public health law violations; provides support for the nursing home quality improvement demonstration program.

sponsored.t: Enacts the voting integrity and verification act of New York (VIVA NY)
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "voting integrity and verification act of New York (VIVA NY)"; provides that each voter is entitled to the use of an individual, voter verifiable paper ballot of the voter's vote and the opportunity to mark it.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sufficiency of the number of judges and justices in districts and courts
sponsored.sum: Directs the legislature to ensure that the number of judges and justices in districts and courts is sufficient; directs the chief administrator of the courts to report on the sufficiency of the number of judges and justices in each court and to make recommendations on such numbers.

sponsored.t: Provides for an adverse inference in disciplinary proceedings against testimony of correction officers who disable cameras
sponsored.sum: Provides for an adverse inference against the testimony of an officer or other employee of the department of corrections and community supervision, where such officer or other employee violated department rules or regulations by turning off a facility camera or body-worn camera or otherwise prevented such camera or cameras from recording the incident which is the subject of such disciplinary proceeding.

sponsored.t: Relates to the dissemination of information pertaining to Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia through the NY Connects: Choices for Long Term Care program
sponsored.sum: Relates to the dissemination of information pertaining to individuals suffering from Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia through the NY Connects: Choices for Long Term Care program.

sponsored.t: Requires an annual report on individuals who are the primary caregiver for an older adult
sponsored.sum: Requires a report on individuals who are the primary caregiver for an older adult, including the number of individuals who are primary caregivers for an older adult, the average age of a primary caregiver, the cost to an individual to provide care to an older adult, and the economic value and savings to the state of such individual's services.

sponsored.t: Establishes the senior center council; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the senior center council for the purposes of providing a forum for discussion of challenges facing senior centers across the state and developing solutions; supports sharing of information regarding efficient and effective operation of senior centers in different areas around the state; encourages the spread of methods and programs with proven effectiveness; creates an environment for peer-to-peer support for senior centers across the state; offers recommendations for how the state can support senior centers and lower barriers to effective service delivery; offers recommendations on existing services and cost effective measures to ensure the long-term sustainability and…

sponsored.t: Authorizes owners of mobile barber shops to obtain barber shop owner's licenses
sponsored.sum: Authorizes owners of mobile barber shops to obtain barber shop owner's licenses provided that they can furnish proof of title, possession, registration and driver's license authorizing operation of the vehicle to be used to operate the mobile barber shop and proof of proper layout, adequate equipment for the shop, sanitary conditions in the shop and good moral character.

sponsored.t: Relates to proceedings for appointment of a guardian for personal needs or property management
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Karilyn's law"; provides that the court set the date for proceedings relating to family visitation under a guardianship petition for not more than ten days from the signing of the order to show cause; provides that visitation shall be a rebuttable presumption.

sponsored.t: Requires biannual certification of cooling towers
sponsored.sum: Requires biannual certification of cooling towers; increases penalties for violations of such reporting requirements.

sponsored.t: Requires notification of residents who are potentially affected by a serious health threat to their water system
sponsored.sum: Requires notification of residents who are potentially affected by a serious health threat to their water system within 24 hours of receiving investigation results.

sponsored.t: Provides for expanded non-medical in-home services, non-institutional respite services, case management services, and ancillary services without a prescription or physician's order; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides for expanded non-medical in-home services, non-institutional respite services, case management services, and ancillary services without a prescription or physician's order; repeals certain cost sharing requirements for such services.

sponsored.t: Requires NYCHA to provide information and trainings to residents regarding resident management corporations
sponsored.sum: Requires NYCHA to provide information and trainings to all residents regarding the formation of resident management corporations, the requirements of such resident management corporations and the potential benefits of creating such resident management corporations.

sponsored.t: Automated identification of eligible participants for the Medicare savings program
sponsored.sum: Identifies and enrolls SNAP program participants who are eligible for the Medicare savings program.
sponsored.fis: There will be some administrative costs for implementation

sponsored.t: Includes doula awareness in the department of health's education and outreach program
sponsored.sum: Includes doula awareness and the advantages of utilizing a doula in the department of health's education and outreach program.

sponsored.t: Establishes the caregiver coordinating commission
sponsored.sum: Establishes the caregiver coordinating commission to review and evaluate statewide planning, development, and implementation of caregiver support services, including respite care, for informal family caregivers caring for those across the lifespan.

sponsored.t: Directs the the state board of real property tax services to conduct a study on the feasibility of amending property tax revisions for senior citizens located in special districts
sponsored.sum: Directs the state board of real property tax services conduct a study on the feasibility of amending property tax revisions for senior citizens located in special districts and provide a report for such study.

sponsored.t: Requires that free menstrual products be provided in the bathrooms of private colleges and universities
sponsored.sum: Requires that free menstrual products be provided in the commonly used bathrooms of private universities.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a Legionnaires' disease awareness and education program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a Legionnaires' disease awareness and education program on the symptoms, diagnosis and treatment of Legionnaires' disease.

sponsored.t: Requires the office for the aging to make an annual report on the budget expenditures on behalf of the senior population of the state
sponsored.sum: Requires the office for the aging to make an annual report on the budget expenditures on behalf of the senior population of the state every April first.

sponsored.t: Provides for including siblings of parents and children of siblings in the definition of "family member" in relation to regulations pertaining to rights of family members
sponsored.sum: Provides for including siblings of parents and children of siblings in the definition of "family member" in relation to regulations pertaining to rights of family members to succeed in certain cases to the rights of certain tenants.
sponsored.fis: None or negligible to the State.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to and signage for lactation rooms in public buildings
sponsored.sum: Relates to access to lactation rooms in public buildings; requires signage for lactation rooms in public buildings.
sponsored.fis: The fiscal impact is expected to be minimal as it involves updating existing resources and installing signage rather than extensive new construction.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York state good guardianship act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York state good guardianship act to establish the statewide initiative of not-for-profit guardians.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state master plan on aging dashboard
sponsored.sum: Requires the state office for the aging to maintain a public facing state master plan on aging dashboard on the public website of the office, which includes real-time information and updates on each proposal in such master plan including legislative and budgetary progress.
sponsored.fis: To be created within existing appropriations. To be determined.

sponsored.t: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits
sponsored.sum: Extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located at 1800 Park Avenue.

sponsored.t: Enacts the lifeline expansion act of 2026
sponsored.sum: Enacts the lifeline expansion act to require all telephone and wireless providers in the state to offer lifeline service to households at or below two hundred percent of the federal poverty level.

sponsored.t: Enacts the citizens utility board act; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Enacts the citizens utility board act; establishes the citizens utility board to represent and protect the interests of the residential utility consumers of this state.

sponsored.t: Prohibits termination of electricity or heat service during forecasts of extreme temperatures
sponsored.sum: Prohibits termination of electricity or heat service during forecasts of 85 degrees or more than or thirty-two degrees or below.

sponsored.t: Relates to a study on the economic impact of the establishment of kitchen incubators
sponsored.sum: Requires the Empire State Development Corporation, in consultation with the department of agriculture and markets and the office of new Americans to conduct a study on the economic impact of the establishment of kitchen incubators; requires a report to the governor and the legislature.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crimes of sex trafficking of a vulnerable person and predatory sex trafficking
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of sex trafficking of a vulnerable person and predatory sex trafficking when a person intentionally advances or profits from prostitution of a vulnerable person.

sponsored.t: Expedites the distributions of funds for the supervision and treatment services for juveniles program
sponsored.sum: Expedites the distributions of funds for the supervision and treatment services for juveniles program; requires that eligible municipalities receive the sum equivalent to at least their last approved supervision and treatment services for juveniles program plan.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting fines for the late payment or evasion of tolls charged by a public authority
sponsored.sum: Limits fines for the late payment or evasion of tolls charged by a public authority to twenty-five percent of the toll owed.

sponsored.t: Requires hospitals to obtain verbal and written informed consent from a patient or representative before including such patient information in a general hospital facility directory
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals to obtain verbal and written informed consent from a patient or representative before including such patient's information in a general hospital facility directory.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements when landlords offer tenants the option of rent reporting
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements when landlords offer tenants the option of rent reporting to a consumer reporting agency to boost such tenant's credit score.

sponsored.t: Requires compliance with the city's uniform land use review procedure
sponsored.ls: New York City Health and Hospitals Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Requires compliance with the city's uniform land use review procedure.

sponsored.t: Requires healthcare facilities to maintain a fifty percent operating threshold of certain reusable healthcare protective textiles in their inventory
sponsored.sum: Requires healthcare facilities to maintain a fifty percent operating threshold of certain reusable healthcare protective textiles in their inventory unless a reprieve is provided for supply chain issues; provides a fine may be assessed for failure to comply, as determined by the commissioner.

sponsored.t: Relates to employee access to lactation rooms in the workplace
sponsored.sum: Relates to employee access to lactation rooms in the workplace; requires that employers post written policies regarding the rights of nursing employees.
sponsored.fis: The bill may impose minimal costs on employers related to the creation or modification of lactation spaces and the development of a written policy. However, these costs are outweighed by the public health bene- fits of increased breastfeeding rates and the support provided to work- ing mothers.

sponsored.t: Establishes how the MTA shall operate the time-delay egress mechanisms
sponsored.sum: Establishes how the MTA shall operate the time-delay egress mechanisms and when such time-delay egress mechanisms may be used.

sponsored.t: Establishes an affordable independent senior housing assistance program
sponsored.sum: Establishes an affordable independent senior housing assistance program which shall provide grants within amounts appropriated or otherwise available therefor to affordable independent senior housing properties to establish and operate resident assistance programs.
sponsored.fis: None. This program would be subject to annual appropriations.

sponsored.t: Includes positive rental payment information reporting in the New York state low income housing tax credit program; requires landlords to offer tenants the option of positive rental payment information reporting
sponsored.sum: Includes positive rental payment information reporting as a preference in the evaluation of project applications in the New York state low income housing tax credit program; requires landlords to offer tenants the option of positive rental payment information reporting; creates notice requirements for the election of positive rental payment information reporting.

sponsored.t: Allows prospective and current agency personnel receive certification through remote training methods
sponsored.sum: Allows prospective and current agency personnel to receive certification through remote training methods.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "consumer grocery pricing fairness act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "consumer grocery pricing fairness act" in relation to ensuring price fairness for covered goods in the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "no toxics tent act"
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of portable temporary shelters for the purposes of prohibitions on the manufacture or sale of products containing highly flammable materials.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Harlem Unified Community Planning urban renewal agency
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Harlem Unified Community Planning urban renewal agency.

sponsored.t: Establishes the statewide fibroid study program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the statewide fibroid study program to study fibroids, the treatment of fibroids, potential barriers to the access of treatment for fibroids, and differences in symptoms and access to treatment for women of color.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the transfer of pregnant and postpartum incarcerated individuals to residential treatment facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the transfer of pregnant and postpartum incarcerated individuals to residential treatment facilities; requires annual reporting on the number of such incarcerated individuals transferred.

sponsored.t: Requires investor-owned energy utilities publish on its customer-facing website both its promotional and educational materials
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "utility materials disclosure act" to require investor-owned energy utilities publish on its customer-facing website both its promotional and educational materials and file such materials with the public service commission.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale and distribution of certain mercury-added lamps
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale and distribution of compact fluorescent mercury-added lamps and linear fluorescent mercury-added lamps on and after January 1, 2029; provides exceptions; allows for sale of otherwise prohibited lamps from existing stock acquired prior to such date.

sponsored.t: Relates to conversions of real property in public housing developments in relation to the RAD program
sponsored.sum: Relates to conversions of real property in public housing developments in relation to the RAD program; sets notice requirements for public housing authorities.

sponsored.t: Relates to add-on payment for pediatric practices that implement the HealthySteps model
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to establish or approve an add-on rate for pediatric practices implementing the HealthySteps model.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Legionnaires' disease prevention act
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of environmental conservation and the department of health, owners or operators of public water systems, and owners or operators of buildings to take actions to prevent and control waterborne pathogens including legionella from source-to-tap.

sponsored.t: Establishes an affirmative defense to certain parking violations for individuals attending religious services
sponsored.sum: Establishes an affirmative defense for certain parking violations for individuals attending religious services.

sponsored.t: Increases personal needs allowance amounts
sponsored.sum: Increases personal needs allowance amounts for individuals who are deemed eligible; requires that payments be subject to an annual adjustment reflecting the latest consumer price index, all items-U.S. city average.

sponsored.t: Creates a transparency database for contracted not-for-profit organizations
sponsored.sum: Creates a transparency database for contracted not-for-profit organizations; provides such database will include those that are in the process of being approved for contracts, that have received certificates of approval, are approved for contracts, have received renewal contracts, or have been the recipient of fully-executed contracts with the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers of the head of the office of mental health and the head of the office for people with developmental disabilities to promulgate rules regarding communications needs of non-English speakers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the powers of the head of the office of mental health and the head of the office for people with developmental disabilities to promulgate rules regarding communications needs of non-English speakers seeking or receiving services; includes the provision of language services and documents in English and the twelve most common non-English languages spoken by individuals in New York State based on United States census data.

sponsored.t: Removes certain language relating to requests for reconsideration of creditor determinations
sponsored.sum: Removes certain conditional language relating to the submission of requests for reconsideration of creditor determinations.

sponsored.t: Provides for the types of damages that may be awarded to the persons for whose benefit an action for wrongful death is brought
sponsored.sum: Provides for the types of damages that may be awarded to the persons for whose benefit an action for wrongful death is brought.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to conduct a study of recreational activity programming in nursing homes
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to conduct a study and prepare a report of recreational activity programming in nursing homes examining the accessibility and inclusivity of programming, including accommodations for residents with physical or cognitive impairments, availability of multilingual services, transportation for off-site programming, and scheduling considerations.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the correctional association to inspect residential juvenile detention facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the correctional association to inspect residential juvenile detention facilities.

sponsored.t: Provides for requirements for vendors who make products available for order and delivery to incarcerated individuals and provide for safe food storage in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to promulgate rules and regulations for requirements for vendors who make products available for order and delivery to incarcerated individuals and provide for safe food storage for incarcerated individuals in their cells.

sponsored.t: Establishes an intensive addiction recovery and mental health integrated services pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes an intensive addiction recovery and mental health integrated services pilot program to support two three-year demonstration programs that provide intensive addiction and mental health integrated services to individuals with significant addiction and mental health issues who have had multiple and frequent treatment episodes.
sponsored.fis: FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS: To be determined.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance policies to include coverage for doula services as required coverage for maternity care
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance policies to include coverage for doula services as required coverage for maternity care.

sponsored.t: Requires health care professionals to prescribe opioid antagonists when prescribing an opioid
sponsored.sum: Requires health care professionals to prescribe opioid antagonists when prescribing an opioid and discuss the dangers of opioid addiction with such patient in a manner consistent with regulations promulgated by the commissioner of health.

sponsored.t: Relates to including dental implants, replacement dental prosthetic appliances, crowns and root canals as medically necessary dental care and services for coverage under the Medicaid program
sponsored.sum: Includes implants, replacement dental prosthetic appliances, crowns and root canals as medically necessary dental care and services for coverage under the Medicaid program if a qualified dentist authorizes the procedures.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the office for the aging to establish, operate and maintain programs for transportation services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the office for the aging to establish, operate and maintain programs for transportation services, or to contract with counties, cities, towns, villages, school districts or public or private nonprofit corporations, associations, institutions, or agencies concerned with the aging, for the operation and maintenance of such programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to special provisions applying to applications for an adult-use retail dispensary license in a city having a population of one million people or more
sponsored.sum: Requires the cannabis board to review the five most recent years of relevant New York police department crime statistics from the precinct wherein the premises of a proposed dispensary is located and review and treat as binding the finding of any resolution passed by the community board regarding an adult-use retail dispensary license application in a city having a population of one million people or more.

sponsored.t: Prohibits insurer from increasing auto insurance premiums upon renewal for persons 60 years of age or over solely on the ground of insureds' age
sponsored.sum: Prohibits insurer from increasing auto insurance premiums upon renewal for persons 60 years of age or over based solely on the ground of the insured's age.

sponsored.t: Establishes a job fair pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a job fair pilot program for certain residents of correctional facilities in the Wende and New York City correctional facility hubs.

sponsored.t: Provides for a right to representation by counsel for certain actions of the parole board
sponsored.sum: Provides for a right to representation by counsel in any proceeding where an incarcerated individual is under consideration for release on parole and where such incarcerated individual is financially unable to retain counsel.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting other qualifying members of a household to qualify for the disability rent increase exemption
sponsored.sum: Permits other qualifying members of a household to qualify the household for the disability rent increase exemption when they are not the head of household.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of health to produce a report on the utilization and activity of the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage program
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health to produce a report on the utilization and activity of the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage program, including future enrollment and program cost projections, and to publish such report and deliver the report to the governor, the temporary president of the senate, and the speaker of the assembly.

sponsored.t: Establishes the adult care facility voucher demonstration program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the adult care facility voucher demonstration program for persons with dementia, Alzheimer's diagnosis, or other cognitive impairments to provide a sliding-scale subsidy for adult care facility residents who are at risk of losing nursing home care due to depleted resources and to individuals who are not eligible for Medicaid or supplemental security income, but in need of adult day care services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits state chartered banking institutions from investing in and providing financing for private prisons
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state chartered banking institutions from investing in and providing financing for private prisons.

sponsored.t: Includes a component on water safety in kindergarten through twelfth grade
sponsored.sum: Includes a component on water safety in kindergarten through twelfth grade.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a uterine fibroids awareness and education program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a uterine fibroids awareness and education program on the symptoms, diagnosis and treatment of uterine fibroids and the elevated risk for minority women.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary commission to study music and performing arts education programs in New York state correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary commission to study music and performing arts education programs in New York state correctional facilities.

sponsored.t: Requires that certain contracts let by the office of general services be reserved for small businesses, including minority-owned business enterprises and women-owned businesses enterprises
sponsored.sum: Requires that certain contracts let by the office of general services be reserved for small businesses, including minority-owned business enterprises and women-owned business enterprises.

sponsored.t: Provides for compensation for required code enforcement personnel training
sponsored.sum: Provides for compensation for required code enforcement personnel training at a rate set by the secretary of state.

sponsored.t: Establishes a free lifeguard training program in high schools in a city with a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Establishes a free lifeguard training program in high schools in a city with a population of one million or more and covers all fees and costs of a state-approved lifeguard certification exam for any student upon completion of the training program.
sponsored.fis: Funding to support the costs for the lifeguard training program for public high school students shall be determined by the department of education.

sponsored.t: Relates to parole eligibility for certain incarcerated persons age fifty-five or older
sponsored.sum: Relates to parole eligibility for certain incarcerated persons age fifty-five or older if they have served at least fifteen years of their sentence or sentences.

sponsored.t: Establishes water safety swim instruction and free swim lessons in schools in a city with a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Establishes a water safety swim instructor certification exam and water safety swim instruction and free swim lessons in schools in a city with a population of one million or more.
sponsored.fis: Funding to support the costs for the water swim safety certification exams and swim lessons for public school students shall be determined by the department of education.

sponsored.t: Provides for the regulation by the department of environmental conservation of business transaction paper containing bisphenol A
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the distribution and use of paper containing bisphenol A for the recording of any business transaction.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the retail sale of flavored tobacco products and accessories
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the retail sale of flavored tobacco products and accessories; imposes a fine of not more than five hundred dollars for each infraction.

sponsored.t: Authorizes renewals to the court of appeals based on a subsequent change in law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes renewals in certain instances by an aggrieved party to the court of appeals based on a subsequent change in law.
sponsored.fis: Possible reduction in overall judicial administrative expenses.

sponsored.t: Requires that any disposition of land or buildings by the New York City Housing Authority be subject to and comply with the provisions of New York City's Uniform Land Use Review Procedure
sponsored.sum: Requires that any disposition of land or buildings by the New York City Housing Authority be subject to and comply with the provisions of New York City's Uniform Land Use Review Procedure.

sponsored.t: Relates to a private right of action concerning sidewalk sheds
sponsored.sum: Creates a private right of action by a tenant against a landlord in a city having a population of one million or more persons over sidewalk sheds.

sponsored.t: Establishes a continuing care retirement community bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Establishes a continuing care retirement community bill of rights; requires the commissioner of health to designate a county ombudsperson to monitor such bill of rights.

sponsored.t: Increases penalties for owners of rent-regulated property who overcharge tenants
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for owners of rent-regulated property who overcharge tenants.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting insurance companies from discriminating based on genetic predisposition; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits insurance companies from discriminating based on genetic predisposition including refusing to issue or renew, charging any increased rate, or restricting any length of coverage; prohibits insurers from requiring genetic testing.

sponsored.t: Requires compliance with the uniform land use review procedure for the disposition of school property in New York city
sponsored.sum: Requires compliance with the uniform land use review procedure for the disposition of school property in New York city.

sponsored.t: Relates to customer service access
sponsored.sum: Requires certain businesses to provide a free, efficient, universally accessible, inclusive, nondiscriminatory and evaluable customer service telephone line; requires corporations to establish an annual customer service call-answer rate of at least ninety percent.

sponsored.t: Relates to the regulation of exhaust gas cleaning systems on vessels; and relates to the powers of the department of environmental conservation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the regulation of exhaust gas cleaning systems on vessels and provides enforcement mechanisms and remedies for violations; relates to the powers of the department of environmental conservation.

sponsored.t: Provides that certain communications made without malice regarding an incident of sexual assault, harassment or discrimination shall be deemed privileged
sponsored.sum: Provides that certain communications made without malice regarding an incident of sexual assault, harassment or discrimination shall be deemed privileged; provides that a prevailing defendant in an action brought against such defendant for making a communication that is privileged shall be entitled to attorney's fees and costs for such defense.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of an algorithmic device by a landlord for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of an algorithmic device by a landlord for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant; declares that such use is an unfair or deceptive trade practice.

sponsored.t: Enacts the rapid engagement initiative act
sponsored.sum: Establishes a program to provide immediate assistance to persons to whom an appearance ticket has been issued in order to address the critical needs of such persons for housing, medical treatment, legal representation, and other requirements.

sponsored.t: Requires that plaintiffs no longer have to prove that a sexual offense occurred on the premises of, chattels or property belonging to a corporate entity
sponsored.sum: Requires that plaintiffs no longer have to prove that a sexual offense occurred on the premises of, chattels or property belonging to a corporate entity in action for negligent supervision.

sponsored.t: Relates to the transfer of funds into the metropolitan transportation authority aid trust account and the public transportation system operating assistance account
sponsored.sum: Relates to the transfer of funds into the metropolitan transportation authority aid trust account and the public transportation system operating assistance account.
sponsored.fis: This legislation does not increase any taxes or fees. It simply dedi- cates a percentage of sales and compensating use tax revenues to tran- sit-related purposes. Based on current ridership data, it is anticipated that revenues dedicated to these accounts will range from twenty-five to fifty cents per ride, depending on the region and price of the ride.

sponsored.t: Lowers quorum requirements for meetings of community boards held by videoconferencing
sponsored.sum: Provides that, for a quorum, an advisory board may require that at a minimum, one quarter of the members and the presiding officer of a community board physically be present at a location where the public can attend for such board to conduct videoconferencing.

sponsored.t: Prohibits bank investments in bad faith landlords
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a state chartered banking institution from providing financing to a landlord who has engaged in certain bad faith acts.

sponsored.t: Relates to major capital improvements and individual apartment improvements in rent regulated units
sponsored.sum: Prohibits temporary major capital improvement increases for buildings where the owner has demonstrated a pattern of violations unless the applicant shows by clear and convincing evidence that the proposed improvement will directly and substantially remedy those violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to records of elevator maintenance or vertical transportation, operation issues and repairs
sponsored.sum: Requires records of elevator or vertical transportation maintenance, operation issues and repairs be made available to the municipal department having jurisdiction over such elevator or vertical transportation.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring all insurance policies and medical assistance to provide coverage for medically necessary hearing aids for children under 16 years of age
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Isabella's law" to require all health insurance policies and medical assistance to provide insurance coverage for the cost of medically necessary hearing aids for children under the age of 16.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the eviction of small commercial tenants in the city of New York without good cause
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the eviction of small commercial tenants in the city of New York without good cause.

sponsored.t: Relates to medical debt
sponsored.sum: Prohibits money judgments arising from non-payment of facility items and services by a patient or patient guarantor that is brought by a facility; prohibits the enforcement of arbitration agreements or clauses with respect to non-payment of facility items and services by a patient or patient guarantor; relates to the collection of medical debt; requires transparency in hospital pricing.

sponsored.t: Requires public housing authorities with housing complexes containing one hundred or more units to provide food and drinking water for all tenants in the affected buildings each day of a water service disruption
sponsored.sum: Requires public housing authorities with housing complexes containing one hundred or more units to provide at least three meals or meal vouchers and drinking water for all tenants in the affected buildings each day of a disruption in water services that requires a pause of tenant use of water for drinking or cooking lasting over twenty-four hours.

sponsored.t: Relates to reducing the speed for owner liability for failure of operator to comply with certain posted maximum speed limits
sponsored.sum: Reduces the speed for owner liability for failure of operator to comply with certain posted maximum speed limits to more than seven miles per hour over such posted maximum speed limits.

sponsored.t: Relates to class actions
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the restriction on class actions involving a penalty or minimum recovery; adds language expressly permitting class actions against governmental entities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the age of persons eligible for a sentence of life imprisonment without parole
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that only persons eighteen years of age and older may be sentenced to life imprisonment without parole.

sponsored.t: Establishes the diversity in investment act requiring certain venture capital companies to report diversity information about its funding determinations
sponsored.sum: Establishes the diversity in investment act requiring certain venture capital companies to report diversity information about its funding determinations; requires reports to be published on the venture capital companies' websites; establishes penalties for failure to complete and publish such reports.

sponsored.t: Relates to the provision of legal representation to certain persons in eviction, ejectment and foreclosure proceedings
sponsored.sum: Requires counties and/or cities to establish a plan for providing legal counsel to persons who are defendants or respondents in eviction, ejectment and foreclosure proceedings and who are financially unable to obtain counsel; defines eligible person as one whose gross individual income is not in excess of one hundred twenty-five percent of the federal income official poverty line; requires the state to match dollar for dollar the amount counties appropriate for their plans.

sponsored.t: Relates to remedies for a violation of the prohibition on a landlord from refusing to rent due to a tenant's involvement in a prior dispute
sponsored.sum: Provides penalties when a landlord of a residential premises refuses to rent to a potential tenant on the basis that the potential tenant was involved in a past or pending landlord-tenant action or summary proceeding.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing grants for the implementation of the seal of civic readiness program
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing grants for the implementation of the seal of civic readiness program; authorizes grants of $50,000 to no more than 20 applicant school districts for public schools that have successfully completed both the seal of civic readiness application and commissioner created grant application.
sponsored.fis: An additional $1 million appropriated to the State Education Department.

sponsored.t: Relates to the liability of a person who makes or uses a false record or statement material to an obligation to pay money to the state or a local government under the tax law
sponsored.sum: Relates to the liability of a person who makes or uses a false record or statement material to an obligation to pay money to the state or a local government under the tax law, or who conceals or improperly avoids or decreases an obligation to pay money to the state or a local government under the tax law.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a crisis intervention team program
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a crisis intervention demonstration program.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have a substantial positive fiscal impact on the City of New York by reducing the legal and settlement costs related to unwar- ranted lethal force against the emotionally impaired. Up to 1 million Dollars from the general fund will be used to establish the program.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York city department of buildings community accountability act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York city department of buildings community accountability act.

sponsored.t: Establishes environmental standards for ambient lead and lead contamination
sponsored.sum: Establishes environmental standards for ambient lead and lead contamination in soils and on floors and window sills.

sponsored.t: Relates to information to be provided with all new and renewal leases for certain housing accommodations
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords of certain housing accommodations to include with all new and renewal leases, on any rent bills, including any electronic communication the informational material describing eligibility for and the benefits of the senior rent increase exemption program and the disability rent increase exemption program.

sponsored.t: Relates to sex offenses involving mental health care providers
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of mental health care provider for the purposes of the penal law; expands the conditions under which a person is deemed incapable of consent.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "real accessible pedestrian signal act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "real accessible pedestrian signal act" in relation to requiring newly installed or constructed pedestrian signal units to be accessible pedestrian signals and to include tactile maps.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Give Kids a Chance - Carter's Law"; mandates health insurance coverage for congenital anomalies
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Give Kids a Chance - Carter's Law" mandating health insurance coverage for congenital anomalies including certain reconstructive services, habilitative services, and inpatient and outpatient services.

sponsored.t: Expands definition of eligible senior citizen and disabled person with respect to condominium and cooperative conversion
sponsored.sum: Expands definition of eligible senior citizen and disabled person to include any member of the tenant's household lawfully occupying the premises as such person's residence who is 62 years of age with respect to condominium and cooperative conversion to provide protection to disabled and senior citizen non-purchasing residents of buildings that undergo cooperative or condominium conversions under an eviction plan even where such residents are not tenants of record in the buildings.

sponsored.t: Establishes a senior housing task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes a senior housing task force for the purposes of conducting a state-wide assessment of senior housing needs taking into consideration the various geographical areas and different needs of the seniors in those areas and resources available in those different areas.

sponsored.t: Relates to contracts and dispute resolution process for billing under contracts for home care services with managed care plans
sponsored.sum: Requires review and approval by the commissioner of health of contracts for home care services provided to a licensed home care services agency from a managed care organization or a managed long term care plan; directs the commissioner of health to establish a dispute resolution process independent dispute resolution relating to billing under a contract for home care services.

sponsored.t: Relates to payment for work by a personal care aide or a home health aide with temporary protected status or other visa status
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers to pay a licensed home care services agency for work provided by a personal care aide or a home health aide with temporary protected status or other visa status; requires the licensed home services agency to have made a good faith effort to establish the employment eligibility of personal care aide or a home health aide consistent with federal regulation and statutes.

sponsored.t: Relates to taxpayer publicly funded research
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "taxpayer access to publicly funded research act"; defines terms; requires each agency that provides funding for direct research shall develop a public access policy.

sponsored.t: Creates the district long-term care ombudsperson council program
sponsored.sum: Creates the district long-term care ombudsperson council program to coordinate volunteer ombudsperson's in each assembly district.
sponsored.fis: This bill requires an annual state appropriation of $86,200 per Assembly district to support the operations of each district council program.

sponsored.t: Establishes the hospice workforce stabilization and innovation program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the hospice workforce stabilization and innovation program; grants for staff retention incentives, continuing education, professional certification including board certification in hospice and palliative care, workforce wellness initiatives, and other workforce support activities approved by the department; creates grants for establishing regional hospice workforce pipeline programs.
sponsored.fis: This legislation calls for a $15 million appropriation to establish the Hospice Workforce Stabilization and Innovation Program.

sponsored.t: Provides for the preservation of records of certain violations in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to promulgate rules and regulations to establish and maintain a system for the preservation of data on tier one violations in correctional facilities.
sponsored.fis: Minimal. Any costs associated with implementing the recordkeeping system are expected to be absorbed by existing administrative budgets.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a community garden grant program for all state university of New York and city university of New York campuses
sponsored.sum: Establishes a community garden grant program for all state university of New York and city university of New York campuses.
sponsored.fis: Grant monies funded and appropriated to SUNY and CUNY institutions shall be determined by the office of community gardens.

sponsored.t: Authorizes farmers' markets to operate on all state university of New York and city university of New York campuses
sponsored.sum: Authorizes farmers' markets to operate on all state university of New York and city university of New York campuses.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for treatments to slow the progression of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias
sponsored.sum: Provides for coverage for treatments to slow the progression of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.

sponsored.t: Relates to rent registration statements filed by a limited liability company
sponsored.sum: Requires that any limited liability company who files a rent registration statement shall include a list of all members of such limited liability company and each member's ownership interest.

sponsored.t: Relates to right of action for claims arising out of coerced debts
sponsored.sum: Relates to actions for claims arising out of coerced debts; limits certain actions; established a right of action against person who causes another to incur coerced debt.

sponsored.t: Relates to commencing a study on the relationship between the corrections system and the child welfare system
sponsored.sum: Relates to commencing a study on the relationship between the corrections system and the child welfare system.

sponsored.t: Relates to the documentation and preservation of Black history in New York state by the state university of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state Black history preservation commission to ensure the documentation and preservation of Black history in New York state within the state university of New York.

sponsored.t: Establishes an elder financial exploitation public awareness campaign
sponsored.sum: Establishes an elder financial exploitation public awareness campaign to educate older adults and persons providing care to older adults on the prevention and detection of financial exploitation.

sponsored.t: Establishes the youth justice innovation fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the youth justice innovation fund to make funds available to community-based organizations for services and programs with the purpose of youth development and preventing youth arrest and incarceration.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for the temporary assistance to needy families block grant program, safety net assistance and medical assistance for certain noncitizens
sponsored.sum: Relates to eligibility for the temporary assistance to needy families block grant program, safety net assistance and medical assistance for certain noncitizens.

sponsored.t: Relates to rates of payment for adult day health care services
sponsored.sum: Modifies the rates of payment related to adult day health care services.

sponsored.t: Establishes the interagency elder justice task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the interagency elder justice task force consisting of representatives of state agencies whose work involves elder justice to create greater collaboration and develop overarching strategies, systems, and programs with a goal of protecting older adults from abuse and mistreatment.

sponsored.t: Creates the office of older adult workforce development within the office for the aging
sponsored.sum: Creates the office of older adult workforce development within the office for the aging to address the needs of older adults regarding the workplace.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing access to resources for culturally diverse arts and culture organizations that advocate for diversity, equity and inclusion, racial and social justice, and cultural preservation
sponsored.sum: Increases access to resources for culturally diverse arts and culture organizations that advocate for diversity, equity and inclusion, racial and social justice, and cultural preservation.

sponsored.t: Allows prospective tenants of rent controlled or rent stabilized housing accommodations to request the complete rent history of such housing accommodations
sponsored.sum: Allows prospective tenants of rent controlled or rent stabilized housing accommodations to request the complete rent history of such housing accommodations.

sponsored.t: Relates to price gouging
sponsored.sum: Relates to price gouging; imposes criminal penalties for price gouging; removes language relating to the declaration of a state of emergency; increases civil penalty; authorizes a district attorney to enforce provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires the metropolitan transit authority establish a thirty-day fare cap program
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan transit authority establish a thirty-day fare cap program which provides customers an unlimited pass for the month after paying a set amount of fares.

sponsored.t: Relates to notification of a senior real property tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Requires a second notification to persons previously eligible for a senior real property tax exemption.

sponsored.t: Establishes a reintegration pilot program for individuals being released from correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs DOCCS, in collaboration with OTDA, OMH and OASAS, to establish a 5-year reintegration pilot program for individuals being released from correctional facilities to provide supports and services to prepare for release, assist with reintegration into the community, and reduce recidivism.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state SNAP minimum benefit enhancement program for senior New Yorkers
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state SNAP minimum benefit enhancement program for senior New Yorkers.
sponsored.fis: : Through the office of the temporary and disability assistance, eligible households are to receive a monthly state SNAP benefit of an additional fifty dollars in addition to the federal SNAP monthly benefit. The state senior SNAP minimum benefit enhancement program shall adhere to the same rules and procedures as federal SNAP, including but not limited to, distributing state SNAP benefit using the program's electronic benefit transfer system for the sole purpose for the purchase of food.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "facial identification and transparency in immigration enforcement act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "facial identification and transparency in immigration enforcement act"; requires federal immigration enforcement agents to identify themselves as such when conducting enforcement activities.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program for schools with active aging programs or specializations in place
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program for schools with active aging programs or specializations in place; creates a curriculum team that shall identify areas that are most relevant to persons working with older adults currently, and/or represent emerging and evidenced-based practices and create a suggested syllabus template for an advanced-year practice class in the field of aging; creates the workforce development center for professional development in gerontological/geriatric education.

sponsored.t: Directs the office of children and family services to conduct a statewide needs assessment
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of children and family services to conduct a statewide needs assessment to identify any unmet needs, including, but not limited to, housing, mental health access, financial assistance, childcare, and respite care access for kinship caregivers.

sponsored.t: Establishes the interagency council on kinship care
sponsored.sum: Establishes the interagency council on kinship care to investigate, evaluate and make recommendations concerning the unique issues of kinship caregivers.

sponsored.t: Relates to paid leave for menopause
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing five days of paid leave for menopause.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to provide a leave of absence for an employee to use for preventative health care measures
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to provide a leave of absence of at least four hours for every 12 month period for an employee to use for preventative health care measures.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to provide a leave of absence for an employee to use for colon cancer screenings
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to provide a leave of absence of at least four hours for every 12 month period for an employee to use for colon cancer screenings.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to provide a leave of absence for an employee to use for menopause
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to provide leave of absence of at least five days for every 12 month period for an employee to use for menopause symptoms; requires the commissioner of labor, in consultation with the commissioner of health, to develop workplace guidance relating to menopause.

sponsored.t: Relates to oversight of continuing care communities; repealer
sponsored.sum: Amends provisions for oversight of continuing care retirement communities.

sponsored.t: Requires the provision of home-delivered meals to eligible homebound older adults on weekends and holidays; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Directs the state office for the aging to establish a grant program for the provision of home-delivered meals to eligible homebound individuals on weekends and state-recognized holidays by eligible entities; requires a report; makes an appropriation therefore.
sponsored.fis: : Such moneys of one hundred million dollars, appropriated to the state office for the aging, shall be made available on or after April first, two thousand twenty-six, and shall remain available to the state office for the aging until expended. The office may use the provisions of this act to provide grants to local governmental units and nonprofit organ- izations. However, the office may retain up to 10 percent of such funds for the purpose of implementing the grant program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the statute of limitations of actions related to certain sex trafficking offenses
sponsored.sum: Extends the statute of limitations of actions related to certain sex trafficking offenses, reviving such actions otherwise barred by the existing statute of limitations; grants trial preference to such actions; exempts such actions from certain provisions requiring notice of claims.

sponsored.t: Establishes the managed long term care high acuity stabilization pool; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the managed long term care high acuity stabilization pool to support managed long term care plans that demonstrate high performance on quality measures established by the department and serve a disproportionately high share of members with complex long term care needs or high service utilization.

sponsored.t: Relates to requisite training for police officers for crimes involving human trafficking; and relates to requisite training for entities providing public transportation
sponsored.sum: Requires state and municipal police academy course training in the recognition and handling of matters involving human trafficking; requires public transportation authorities and contractors to provide training in the recognition and handling of matters involving human trafficking.

sponsored.t: Requires the division of housing and community renewal, with the state office for the aging, to establish a database of available senior housing; requires the office for the aging to maintain such database
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of housing and community renewal, in collaboration with the New York state office for the aging, to establish a publicly accessible online database of available senior housing units; requires the New York state office for the aging to maintain the senior housing unit database.

sponsored.t: Requires the recording and posting of certain public hearings
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Requires certain public hearings held by the New York state urban development corporation to be recorded and such recordings be posted to the corporation's website within forty-eight hours.

sponsored.t: Requires alternating high and low, two-toned signal devices on emergency services vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires alternating high and low, two-toned signal devices on emergency services vehicles in New York city.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring a referenced rate for prescription drugs
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program on the referenced rate for prescription drugs; relates to reducing the cost of prescription drugs by establishing maximum wholesale drug prices that are the same as the prices in Canada.

sponsored.t: Establishes a public awareness campaign related to maternal depression; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes a public awareness campaign related to maternal depression; establishes the maternal depression fund; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of interference with constitutional rights by public officials
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of interference with constitutional rights by public officials when, acting under color of law, such public official by force or threat of force, or by intimidation or coercion, recklessly engages in conduct which injures, intimidates, interferes with, or attempts to injure, intimidate, or interfere with another person in the free exercise or enjoyment of any right or privilege secured by the constitution or laws of the United States; or the constitution or laws of the state of New York; provides such offense is a class A misdemeanor which elevates if bodily injury occurs.

sponsored.t: Provides practical support for access to abortion care
sponsored.sum: Provides practical support for access to abortion care including, but not limited to, reimbursement for ground and air transportation, lodging, meals, childcare, translation services, and doula support.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility requirements for rent increase exemptions for persons with disabilities
Requires the state office for the aging to publish a "Guide to Actions When Someone Close Dies"
sponsored.sum: Requires the state office for the aging to publish a "Guide to Actions When Someone Close Dies".

sponsored.t: Enacts the "fair pay for home care act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "fair pay for home care act" relating to minimum wages applicable to home care aides; provides for a minimum wage of 150% of the applicable statewide or regional minimum wage.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of infant walkers in child care facilities; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of infant walkers in child care facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the family essential program
sponsored.sum: Creates the family essential program within the office for the aging to provide for advocacy, collaborative and education infrastructure for essential family caregivers within nursing homes and other long term care communities.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "age-friendly health system enhancement act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes an age-friendly health system technical assistance center to provide assistance in relation to age-friendly health systems; relates to hospital performance data.

sponsored.t: Relates to the standards of monthly need for persons in receipt of public assistance
sponsored.sum: Relates to the standards of monthly need for persons in receipt of public assistance; provides for an increased monthly allowance for persons and families residing in shelters.

sponsored.t: Establishes and funds the close the waitlist fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes and funds the close the waitlist fund by utilizing a tax surcharge to pay for providing senior services to individuals who have been waitlisted to receive such senior services.
sponsored.fis: Cost neutral for state and local governments.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of income property owners may earn for the purpose of eligibility for the property tax exemption for persons over sixty-five years of age
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of income property owners may earn for the purpose of eligibility for the property tax exemption for persons over sixty-five years of age; increases such amount to $75,000.

sponsored.t: Enacts the supportive housing modernization act
sponsored.sum: Establishes a five-year window for any entity participating in the New York state supportive housing program (NYSSHP) in good standing with such program to participate in a request for proposal to increase their contract rates up to ESSHI levels.

sponsored.t: Requires intervention in incidents involving incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Requires every police officer, peace officer and employee of a correctional facility to intervene in incidents of violence involving incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Prohibits interference with the provision of medical assistance to incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Prohibits any police officer, peace officer or employee of a correctional facility from interfering with the provision of medical assistance to an incarcerated individual.

sponsored.t: Repeals the Columbia University Education Mixed-Use Development Land Use Improvement and Civic Project Modified General Project Plan adopted by the empire state development corporation on December 18, 2008
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Repeals the Columbia University Education Mixed-Use Development Land Use Improvement and Civic Project Modified General Project Plan adopted by the empire state development corporation on December 18, 2008.

sponsored.t: Prohibits law enforcement officers from using bias-based profiling
sponsored.sum: Prohibits police officers from using bias-based profiling; requires that a procedure be established for the taking and review of complaints against police officers for bias-based profiling; allows an action for injunctive relief and/or damages to be brought against a law enforcement agency, any agent of a law enforcement agency and the supervisor of an agent.
sponsored.fis: Related to the promulgation of regulations, the collection of data, the publishing of an annual report and the establishment of the public data base.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the creation of state debt in creating the save public housing bond act of 2025 and provides for submission to the people of such proposal
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the creation of state debt in the amount of 20 billion dollars in relation to enacting the save public housing bond act of 2025; provides for submission to the people of such proposal.

sponsored.t: Provides for the conversion of condominium ownership for the preservation of expiring affordable housing in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to the conversion to condominium ownership for the preservation of expiring affordable housing in the city of New York; provides expanded homeownership opportunities from the conversion of certain residential rental buildings to condominium status by property owners that commit to preserve the inventory of expiring affordable housing in the city of New York.
sponsored.fis: There are no fiscal implications created by this bill other than being revenue accretive to the City and State, when one accounts for new transfer taxes, mortgage recording taxes, mansion taxes, and additional revenue to assist the operations of the real estate finance bureau of the Attorney General's office.

sponsored.t: Requires the replacement of certain rent stabilized housing accommodations
sponsored.sum: Requires rent stabilized housing accommodations lost or destroyed due to fire, natural disaster, act of God, act of war or eminent domain, to be replaced in any succeeding construction on the same parcel.

sponsored.t: Requires certain employees of the New York state department of corrections and community supervision to wear body cameras
sponsored.sum: Requires every parole officer and employee of the department of corrections and community supervision to wear body cameras with video and audio whenever they are interacting with a parolee; implements the use of cameras in every official office and room in the department.

sponsored.t: Removes the lifetime ban on jury duty for convicted felons
sponsored.sum: Removes the lifetime ban on jury duty for convicted felons.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to publicly post certain information after the death of an individual in the custody of the department
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of corrections and community supervision to publicly post the name, identifying information and a summary incident report after the death of an individual in the custody of the department.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending provisions of law relating to the New York state adult cystic fibrosis program
sponsored.sum: Relates to extending provisions of law relating to the New York state adult cystic fibrosis program until 2030.

sponsored.t: Increase the amount of family leave time that may be taken in a year
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of family leave time that may be taken in a year.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of the savings exemption for eligibility for Medicaid
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of the savings exemption for eligibility for Medicaid.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the expanded pharmaceutical insurance coverage panel
sponsored.sum: Relates to improving and expanding the pharmaceutical insurance coverage program for certain medicare enrollees; creates the expanded pharmaceutical insurance coverage panel, to be responsible for expanding pharmaceutical insurance coverage.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of infant loungers and restricts the use of such infant loungers in certain settings
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of infant loungers; restricts the use of such infant loungers in certain settings; defines an infant lounger to mean a padded pillow or cushioned product, sometimes with a lower indented region, used to support or hug an infant as it lies face up, primarily intended and marketed for the support of an infant while awake.

sponsored.t: Provides for due process procedures for certain persons who have received an offer for transitional care or certain care prior to becoming eligible to receive such care
sponsored.sum: Provides for due process procedures for persons who currently are placed in New York state education department approved out-of-state residential schools pursuant to the education law and the federal individuals with disabilities education act who have received an offer for transitional care or certain care prior to becoming eligible to receive such care.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal history background checks for the purchase of three-dimensional printers capable of creating firearms
sponsored.sum: Requires a criminal history background check for the purchase of a three-dimensional printer capable of creating firearms; prohibits sale to a person who would be disqualified on the basis of criminal history from being granted a license to possess a firearm.

sponsored.t: Allocates fines imposed on real estate appraisers to the anti-discrimination in housing fund
sponsored.sum: Allocates fines imposed on real estate appraisers to the anti-discrimination in housing fund; provides that a fine not exceeding two thousand dollars may be imposed on real estate appraisers for certain acts or omissions.

sponsored.t: Requires rear occupant alert systems in certain vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires rear occupant alert systems in certain vehicles.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "consumer protection and automotive transparency act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the consumer protection and automotive transparency act mandating transparency in automotive labeling relating to materials used in motor vehicles.
sponsored.fis: The implementation of this legislation is expected to have positive fiscal implications. By promoting transparency and informed consumer choices, the bill may reduce instances of consumer dissatisfaction and related disputes, leading to potential cost savings in dispute resol- ution processes. Additionally, the bill aims to create a fair and competitive marketplace, potentially enhancing economic activities with- in the automotive industry. The Department of Consumer Affairs may incur enforcement-related costs, but the long-term benefits to consumers and the marketplace are anticipated to outweigh these expenses.

sponsored.t: Requires all residential leases to disclose tenants' rights
sponsored.sum: Provides that all residential leases shall contain a detailed description of tenant's statutory rights including among others, warranty of habitability, willful violation of lease, right to participate in tenants' associations, no eviction for good faith complaint, utility payment offset and sublet rights; grants tenant the right to install extra locks; sets out landlord obligations with respect to heating and oil delivery.

sponsored.t: Relates to manufacturers' reporting the sale or distribution of firearms
sponsored.sum: Relates to manufacturers' reporting the sale or distribution of firearms to the department of criminal justice services.

sponsored.t: Names a certain state facility after Willie Mae "Goody" Goodman
sponsored.sum: Names an office for people with developmental disabilities facility located in the borough of Manhattan the "Willie Mae 'Goody' Goodman Community Facility".

sponsored.t: Establishes the Marshall plan for moms interagency task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Marshall plan for moms interagency task force to examine, issue proposals and make recommendations on multiple policy areas to address the disproportionate burden mothers have weathered from the economic fallout of the COVID-19 pandemic.

sponsored.t: Requires exterior cages for air conditioners
sponsored.sum: Requires exterior cages for air conditioners installed in any multiple dwelling.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to promote participation in Nourish New York program for black indigenous and people of color site controlled farms
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to promote participation in Nourish New York, including financial and technical support, for black, indigenous and people of color site controlled farms.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to facilitate and expand an initiative to promote opportunities for farm ownership to farmers who are black, indigenous and people of color
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of agriculture and markets to facilitate and expand an initiative to promote opportunities for farm ownership to farmers who are black, indigenous and people of color; requires the department to submit a triennial report to the governor and the legislature regarding such initiative.

sponsored.t: Establishes a co-navigation services program for persons who are deaf-blind
sponsored.sum: Establishes a co-navigation services program for persons who are deaf-blind to provide services to a person who is deaf-blind that assist the person to physically access the person's environment and to make informed decisions, including providing visual and environmental information or sighted guide services and assisting with communication accessibility by communicating in the preferred language and communication mode of the person who is deaf-blind.

sponsored.t: Relates to gender balance in public authorities, industrial development agencies and local development corporations
sponsored.sum: Relates to gender balance on boards of state and local public authorities; provides that all appointive state and local authorities heretofore or hereafter established by law or resolution shall have recommendations for appointments, or reappointments that are gender balanced.

sponsored.t: Provides for insurance and medicaid coverage for standard fertility preservation services provided due to iatrogenic infertility
sponsored.sum: Provides that Medicaid and policies issued in this state that provide coverage for hospital, surgical or medical care shall provide coverage for standard fertility preservation services when a necessary cancer treatment may directly or indirectly cause iatrogenic infertility to a covered person.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of economic development to conduct a study regarding increasing public access to museums in New York city
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of economic development, in conjunction with various departments and offices, to conduct a study regarding increasing public access to museums in New York city; directs a report on such study to be submitted no later than one year after the effective date.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for approval of charter school applications
sponsored.sum: Expands the total enrollment percentage standard for school districts located in a city with a population of one million or more from applying to initial charter school applications to all charter school applications.

sponsored.t: Repeals paragraph (e) of subdivision 3 of section 2853 of the education law
sponsored.sum: Repeals paragraph (e) of subdivision 3 of section 2853 of the education law.
